reading: The sketch lays out a GitHub-style pull-request review page: a full-width top bar with PR title, an Open pill and merge status, a tab row underneath, a green Review-changes button, a left file-tree sidebar running the page height, a large two-column diff panel, and a comment-thread panel below it with a reply box.

actions.instruction: Top bar 110px tall across the whole page at the very top, no fill (page colour), with a 1px #d0d7de line under it. Only these parts inside it, each absolutely p
Tab row below the top bar, 4 separate real elements with live text, each a one-line nowrap label with its count (min-width, not fixed, so the count never wraps
Green button "Review changes ▾" near the top-right of the header area: 143x31px, barely rounded (border-radius 6px, NOT a pill), #1f883d fill with white (#fffff
Left file-tree sidebar: a 250x790px column at 0,110 with a 1px #d0d7de rule down its right edge and 14px padding. 7 separate stacked lines (12px text, 24px line
Diff panel: one 990x405px bordered (1px #d0d7de, 6px rounded, no fill) panel at 270,130 containing a two-column unified code diff for src/pricing/cache.ts. Head
Comment thread panel below the diff: one 960x171px bordered (1px #d0d7de, 6px rounded, no fill) panel at 285,355 containing two comments and a reply box. First
